entries.basis: Exact Nintendo Switch 2 console (2025), not the 2017 Switch. Four original hardware reviews opened (Engadget, Tom's Guide, Gizmodo, TechRadar); passages are praise for the hardware, dated by publication-day metadata. Sentiment describes each passage.

reviews.title: Nintendo Switch 2 review: More of what you love
reviews.quote: The Switch 2 has everything that made the original so great, but now there's more of it to enjoy.

reviews.title: Nintendo Switch 2 review — no gimmicks here, just a fantastic hybrid console
reviews.quote: Nintendo Switch 2 feels like the ultimate version of the Switch concept, taking everything great about its predecessor and buffing it to a fine sheen.

reviews.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Review: The Ultimate Handheld and It's Not Even Close
reviews.quote: The Switch 2 is the communal console for our current gaming era.

reviews.title: Nintendo Switch 2 review: an evolution in almost every way
reviews.quote: The Nintendo Switch 2 is an apt name for the company's latest console, as it is essentially a more powerful version of its predecessor.

entries.basis: Exact Sony PlayStation 5 launch console (Nov 2020). Engadget and The Next Web launch reviews (original Nov 6, 2020 days) and Tom's Hardware's review (current page date is a later update, so publishedDate left null). Sentiment describes each passage.

reviews.title: PlayStation 5 review: Great 4K gaming with an odd design
reviews.quote: This is the ideal next-generation console from Sony, with powerful hardware, fast load times, a great controller and a choice selection of launch titles.

reviews.title: PlayStation 5 review: Bold and beautiful
reviews.quote: The PlayStation 5 is a brilliant console that will be a great showcase for next-gen games — whenever we eventually get them.

reviews.title: PlayStation 5 Review: Tower of Power
reviews.quote: The Sony PlayStation 5 is a powerful game console with an incredible controller and tons of potential.

entries.basis: Reviews of the Xbox Series X (the pin covers Series X and Series S; none of these passages claims to rate the Series S). Original TechCrunch (Nov 5) and The Next Web (Nov 11) days; Tom's Hardware and TechRadar page dates are later updates so publishedDate is null. Sentiment describes each passage.

reviews.title: Xbox Series X Review: Game Pass to the Future
reviews.quote: The Xbox Series X is a powerful console with good looks, quiet operation, and backwards compatibility for both games and accessories, launching Xbox into a new era and offering gamers a ton of choices in how they play.

reviews.title: Review: Microsoft's Xbox Series X is ahead of its time
reviews.quote: The Series X is just a giant black box that plays games better than any Xbox before it.

reviews.title: Xbox Series X review: Give this beautiful cinderblock games
reviews.quote: Overall, the Series X feels a little safe for a next-gen console, but only in the sense that its upgrades are not flashy ones.

reviews.title: Xbox Series X review: a tower of power
reviews.quote: The Xbox Series X utilizes its powerful specs to significantly reduce load times and improve game performance and visual fidelity.

entries.basis: Exact original PlayStation 4 (Nov 2013). Engadget (Nov 14) and Fortune (Nov 13) launch-week reviews; bit-tech's UK launch review (page date is not clearly original, so null). Fortune's passage is critical. Sentiment describes each passage.

reviews.title: PlayStation 4 review: fast, powerful, worth it

reviews.title: PlayStation 4 Review

entries.basis: Exact original Xbox One (Nov 2013). Engadget (Nov 22) and Fortune (Nov 20) launch reviews. Engadget's passage is a measured verdict. Sentiment describes each passage.

reviews.title: Review: Xbox One
reviews.quote: The success of the Xbox One is largely dependent on what you need for the living room, and whether you intend to use the system for multiple forms of media, with multiple people in mind.

reviews.title: Xbox One review: This is the console of the future
reviews.quote: A new console may live or die based on its initial games, and here is where the Xbox One trumps the PlayStation 4.

reviews.title: Review: The Switch Is the Nintendo System We’ve Been Waiting For
